summary: KKR FS Income Trust Select, a non-traded Delaware BDC, filed an 8-K reporting a routine monthly issuance under its continuous private offering. On September 1, 2026 it sold 211,475.523 Class I shares to accredited investors for about $5.255 million under subscription agreements, exempt via Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. NAV per Class I share was $24.85 at August 31, 2026, with aggregate NAV of roughly $996.3 million. The offering, up to $5.0 billion, has placed 40,964,301.187 Class I shares for about $1.041 billion. No special-situation event; watch ongoing monthly NAV-based subscriptions.
